verdict.rationale: CrewAI Enterprise (AMP) documents 'Webhook Streaming' to stream real-time events to external systems, which supports webhook-based event subscription, but this is an enterprise/paid add-on rather than a core open-source framework feature and lacks detail on subscription configuration or payload/event schema. missing for 10: open-source/self-host webhook support, documentation of event types and payload schema, independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook subscription working.
